falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,700 on any single day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 low equivalent (adjusted for pattern) would invalidate the bottom_2024_aug pattern match, as that bottom held with no lower lows; this would confirm continuation lower not a bottom

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom saw VIX peak near 28 and rapidly compress; sustained VIX above 35 indicates panic escalation not capitulation exhaustion, invalidating the 'blowoff score of 38' as insufficient for marking a bottom

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% while S&P 500 is simultaneously below 5,000
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would signal a flight-to-safety recession panic rather than a growth-scare bottom; the August 2024 bottom featured yields stable/rising with equities stabilizing, so this divergence breaks the pattern's macro regime

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
